WHO WE ARE

Greg and Nikki Stephens own Rocky River Farms, located just outside of Wesley Chapel, North Carolina. Our farm journey began in 2015, when we sold our business and home in Charlotte in search of a different lifestyle. With both of us coming from families rooted in dairy and beef cattle farming, a rural lifestyle felt like the natural next chapter.

We found and began restoring a rundown chicken farm in Union County, between Wesley Chapel and Monroe. Over time, we expanded the farm to include beef cattle, chickens, pigs, ducks, and rabbits—providing farm-fresh products that are wholesome, responsibly raised, and full of flavor.

Driven by a passion to produce the finest beef possible, we’ve worked hard to raise top-quality, tender, and mouth-watering cuts of meat. Our beef is raised without added growth hormones or antibiotics. Our grass-fed cows are pasture-raised and fed a special protein mix that supports digestion and enhances marbling and tenderness. Once mature, our cattle are processed at a USDA-inspected facility and dry-aged for 21 to 28 days before being packaged for you, our customers. We also offer pastured pork and farm-fresh, cage-free chicken eggs.

Our animals are cared for to the highest standards. We are proud to be recognized with Animal Welfare Approved (AWA) and A Greener World certifications, acknowledging our commitment to ethical and sustainable farming.

While we strive to raise and produce everything here at Rocky River Farms, there are times when demand exceeds what we can supply directly. In these instances, we partner with carefully selected farms that share our strict standards for animal welfare, sustainable practices, and product quality. These trusted partners help us continue delivering the products you love—always with the same integrity and care you’ve come to expect from us.

PRODUCTS
PASTURE RAISED BEEF

Our beef is all natural and raised on our own pastures at our Animal Welfare Certified farm in NC. Our beef is antibiotic free and we add no extra hormones to our live stock. We harvest our beef and dry age them for a 21 to 28 day aging period, that give our beef a more tender tasteful meet with every bite. Thus giving you our customer the best beef money can buy.

SHOP ONLINE
PASTURED PORK

Our pork is something you must try to really understand the full flavor of our little pigs that are raised especially for your table and your eating enjoyment.

SHOP ONLINE
HONEY

Our golden pure raw honey comes from thousands of little honey bees that fly around and gather nectar and return to their hive to produce the best honey available on the market.

SHOP ONLINE
EGGS

Our chickens have full run of our farm to deliver only the best free range and cage free eggs just for you. They make the best omelets you will ever have. The eggs are fabulous just for eating, or use them in all your baking needs.

SHOP ONLINE
VINEGARS & OILS

Get ready for the ultimate taste that has ever hit your taste buds. Coming straight from Greece they are like nothing you will ever find in a grocery store. Wonderful on salads or for all your cooking needs.

SHOP ONLINE
ELDERBERRY SYRUP

Sweet's Elderberry Syrup treats symptoms of coughs, colds, allergies, and the flu. When taken regularly, Sweet's Syrup boosts the immune system to help prevent sickness. Made with a short list of quality ingredients, Sweet's Elderberry Syrup tastes delicious and is safe for anyone old enough to consume honey.
